run.question: I need to find a field in the app-193-telemetry index that's used for tracking transactions. The field name should contain 'transaction'. Can you search the mappings and tell me the exact field name?

report.summary: The mapping of the Elasticsearch index app-193-telemetry contains exactly one field whose name contains 'transaction': du_transaction_id_7k3m. It is a text field with a keyword sub-field (ignore_above 256). A sampled document in the index carries a value of 'TXN-98765' in that field, consistent with transaction tracking. Note that the exact name is not a plain 'transaction_id'; a query for a field of that name in this index is not supported by the mapping that was read.

Filtering the mapping's top-level properties of app-193-telemetry for names matching the case-insensitive regex 'transaction' returned exactly one field: du_transaction_id_7k3m, with mapping type text.

A document returned from app-193-telemetry (_id FvlW_aEBFz7Q4KB3oBy2) holds the value "TXN-98765" in the field du_transaction_id_7k3m.

du_transaction_id_7k3m is the transaction-tracking field the question refers to; the TXN-98765 value pattern supports this, but no field description or mapping-level doc comment was found to confirm the intended semantics, and the affixes 'du_' and '_7k3m' do not identify an owning service from this evidence alone.

gaps: The exact field name is du_transaction_id_7k3m, not transaction_id or transactions; nothing under a plain 'transaction_id' name was returned by the filtered mapping query, so if a different exact name was expected it is not present in this mapping as read.

The mapping query is the state at query time (no time range) and does not prove which fields existed during the incident window; only one document lies in the sampled window and only its single field value was read.
The mapping read was filtered to names containing 'transaction'; fields relating to transactions under unrelated names (for example 'txn_*') were not enumerated, so their existence is unknown.
next_steps: If the field is needed in a query, use du_transaction_id_7k3m or its keyword sub-field du_transaction_id_7k3m.keyword for exact-term filters and aggregations.
